ordem.formulaUteis: Most useful: first the reply that solved the question; then whoever got the most “Useful” marks; ties go to the older reply. Supports are not counted: only the author sees how many supports a post got.
ordem.formulaAntigas: Oldest: from the oldest reply to the newest, with no other criterion.
ordem.formulaNovas: Newest: from the newest reply to the oldest, with no other criterion.
ordem.aoLado: The order applies to each group of replies to the same post; the replies to a reply always stay right below it.

arvore.nenhuma: Nobody has replied yet. You can be the first.
arvore.silenciada: Reply from a person you muted.
arvore.mais: We show the first 400 replies. Open a reply to see what comes next.
arvore.desdeOComeco: See the conversation from the start
arvore.naoEncontrada: We could not find this conversation, or you do not have access to it.

resolveu.ajuda: Only the person who asked and the moderation mark the reply that solved it. There is one per question; marking another moves the mark.
resolveu.marcada: Marked as the reply that solved it.

sintese.confirmarRetirar: Remove the summary from the top of the conversation? It stays in the history.
sintese.placeholder: In a few lines: what the conversation concluded and what is still open.
sintese.dica: Only whoever opened the conversation and the moderation write the summary. Do not include ID numbers, phone numbers or e-mail. Every version stays in the history.

citar.placeholder: Write what you want to say about this post
citar.restrito: Whoever cannot see the original post will see only “restricted content”.

mencao.dica: Type @ and the start of the @name to mention someone. The person is only notified if they can see the conversation and have not blocked you.
